title: Monkey D. Luffy
summary: Monkey D. Luffy is the captain of the Straw Hat Pirates and the main protagonist of One Piece. He left East Blue to find the One Piece and become the Pirate King.
personality: Cheerful, fearless and stubborn, Luffy values freedom above all else. His loyalty to friends is absolute, and his instincts often guide him better than logic.
abilities: User of the Gomu Gomu no Mi, giving rubber physiology. He masters advanced Haki (Observation, Armament, Conqueror’s) and develops Gear forms to amplify his strength.
dream: Luffy’s dream is to become the Pirate King, meaning having the most freedom on the seas.
extra_notes: Luffy’s "D" initial, connection to Shanks, Garp, Ace and Dragon place him at the center of world events.

title: Roronoa Zoro
summary: Zoro is Luffy’s first crewmate and the Straw Hats’ swordsman. He fights using the Three-Sword Style.
personality: Serious, disciplined and honor-bound. Constantly trains, extremely loyal to Luffy, and willing to sacrifice himself for the crew.
abilities: Santoryu swordsmanship, advanced Armament and Observation Haki, unbelievable endurance.
dream: Become the world’s greatest swordsman.
extra_notes: Trained by Dracule Mihawk during the timeskip.

title: Nami
summary: Nami is the navigator of the Straw Hat Pirates.
personality: Practical, intelligent and resourceful. Motivated by survival, money and the dream of mapping the world.
abilities: Master navigator, Clima-Tact weather-based fighting style, later upgrades with Zeus.
dream: Draw a complete map of the world.
extra_notes: Her traumatic past with Arlong fuels her hatred of oppression.

title: Usopp
summary: Usopp is the Straw Hats’ sniper and inventor.
personality: Cowardly at times but extremely brave when it matters. Creative and emotional, often the heart of the crew.
abilities: Long-range sniping, trick-based weapons, Pop Greens plant ammunition.
dream: Become a brave warrior of the sea.
extra_notes: Undergoes major growth during the Water 7 and Dressrosa arcs.

title: Sanji
summary: Sanji is the chef of the Straw Hats and fights using powerful kicks.
personality: Chivalrous, calm and flirtatious. Deeply respects food and never harms women.
abilities: Black Leg Style kicks, sky walk, fire-based Diable Jambe, strong Observation Haki.
dream: Find the All Blue.
extra_notes: Born into the Vinsmoke family but rejects their ideology.

title: Tony Tony Chopper
summary: Chopper is the doctor of the Straw Hats and a reindeer who ate the Human-Human Fruit.
personality: Gentle, curious and hardworking. Seeks recognition and acceptance.
abilities: Multiple Zoan transformations, Monster Point with Rumble Balls.
dream: Become a doctor who can cure any disease.
extra_notes: Often underestimated due to his cute appearance.

title: Nico Robin
summary: Nico Robin is the archaeologist of the Straw Hats and one of the few who can read Poneglyphs.
personality: Calm, intelligent, introverted but warm toward the crew.
abilities: Hana-Hana no Mi lets her sprout limbs anywhere; highly skilled historian.
dream: Uncover the True History.
extra_notes: Her existence threatens the World Government’s secrets.

title: Franky
summary: Franky is the Straw Hats’ shipwright and a cola-powered cyborg.
abilities: Cyborg modifications, heavy artillery, engineering mastery.
dream: Build a ship capable of sailing around the world.
extra_notes: Built the Thousand Sunny using Adam Wood.

title: Brook
summary: Brook is the musician of the Straw Hats and a revived skeleton.
personality: Polite, comedic, emotional beneath his calm demeanor.
abilities: Soul-based powers from the Revive-Revive Fruit, ice manipulation, sword techniques.
dream: Reunite with Laboon.
extra_notes: Known for his musical influence across the world.

title: Jinbe
summary: Jinbe is the helmsman of the Straw Hats and a master of Fish-Man Karate.
abilities: Fish-Man Karate, immense physical strength, underwater superiority.
dream: Achieve coexistence between humans and fish-men.
extra_notes: Former Warlord who sacrificed much for Luffy and the crew.

title: Grand Line
summary: The Grand Line is the most dangerous sea in the world, divided by the Red Line and calm belts.
extra_notes: Contains unpredictable climates and legendary islands; home to the New World.

title: Devil Fruits
summary: Devil Fruits grant supernatural powers at the cost of losing the ability to swim.
abilities: Three main types: Paramecia, Zoan and Logia. Zoans include Ancient and Mythical variants.
extra_notes: Their origins and reincarnation mechanics remain one of the world’s greatest mysteries.

title: Haki
summary: Haki is a spiritual force that allows users to sense, harden or overwhelm.
abilities: Three types: Observation, Armament, Conqueror’s.
extra_notes: Mastery varies widely; rare individuals awaken unique forms.

title: Yonko
summary: The Yonko are four pirate captains who rule the New World.
extra_notes: Membership changes after major events involving Blackbeard and Luffy’s rise.

title: Marines
summary: The Marines enforce order across the seas under the World Government.
extra_notes: They maintain Admirals, Vice-Admirals and elite units.

title: World Government
summary: The World Government oversees most nations through force, diplomacy and secrecy.
extra_notes: Hides truths about history and controls Cipher Pol agencies.

title: Revolutionary Army
summary: The Revolutionary Army seeks to overthrow the World Government.
extra_notes: Led by Monkey D. Dragon, operates through global cells.

title: Worst Generation
summary: The Worst Generation consists of powerful rookie pirates entering the New World at the same time.
extra_notes: Several members rise to major positions in later eras.

title: Bounties
summary: Bounties reflect how much threat a person poses, not pure strength.
extra_notes: Major battles or events can rapidly raise or lower bounties.

title: East Blue
summary: East Blue is the birthplace of several Straw Hats and the starting point of the story.
extra_notes: Known as the weakest sea but home to legendary figures.

title: Alabasta Arc
summary: The Straw Hats help Princess Vivi stop Crocodile from causing a civil war.
extra_notes: Crocodile is defeated, saving the kingdom.

title: Skypiea Arc
summary: The crew reaches Skypiea, confronts Enel and uncovers ancient history.
extra_notes: Links strongly to the Void Century.

title: Water 7 & Enies Lobby
summary: The Straw Hats declare war on the World Government to rescue Robin.
extra_notes: Franky joins the crew after the events.

title: Thriller Bark
summary: The crew confronts Gecko Moria and reclaim stolen shadows.
extra_notes: Brook joins the crew in this arc.

title: Sabaody Archipelago
summary: At Sabaody, the crew confronts Celestial Dragons and the Navy, triggering a battle they cannot win.
extra_notes: Kuma scatters the crew worldwide, marking the end of the first half of the story.

title: Amazon Lily
summary: Luffy lands on an island of warrior women and meets Boa Hancock.
extra_notes: Hancock helps Luffy infiltrate Impel Down.

title: Impel Down
summary: Luffy invades the underwater prison Impel Down to rescue Ace.
extra_notes: Luffy allies with former enemies and escapes with a massive breakout.

title: Marineford War
summary: A massive war erupts between Whitebeard’s forces and the Marines to rescue Ace.
extra_notes: Ace and Whitebeard die, reshaping global power and traumatising Luffy.

title: Post-War & Timeskip
summary: After Marineford, Luffy trains for two years with Rayleigh while the crew grows stronger separately.
extra_notes: The timeskip marks the beginning of a stronger, more mature crew.

title: Punk Hazard
summary: The crew uncovers Caesar Clown’s experiments and forms an alliance with Law.
extra_notes: This arc sets up Dressrosa and the eventual clash with Kaido.

title: Dressrosa
summary: The alliance topples Doflamingo, freeing Dressrosa from his tyrannical rule.
extra_notes: Many future allies join the Straw Hats after this battle.

title: Zou
summary: The crew meets the Minks and learns about the Road Poneglyphs on the back of Zunesha.
extra_notes: Zunesha is a living ancient elephant carrying an entire civilization.

title: Whole Cake Island
summary: Luffy infiltrates Big Mom’s territory to rescue Sanji from a political marriage.
extra_notes: Luffy faces Katakuri and achieves a major Haki breakthrough.

title: Wano Arc
summary: In isolated Wano, the alliance battles Kaido and Orochi to free the nation.
extra_notes: The fall of Kaido reshapes Yonko balance and global power.

title: Kaido
summary: Kaido is a Yonko and Wano’s central antagonist, known as the 'Strongest Creature.'
personality: Brutal, domineering and obsessed with creating a war-torn world.
abilities: Mythical Zoan Dragon transformation, overwhelming strength, advanced Haki.
dream: Create a world ruled by strength.
extra_notes: His defeat marks a historic shift in New World power.

title: Charlotte Linlin (Big Mom)
summary: Big Mom is a Yonko ruling Totto Land with her massive family crew.
abilities: Soru Soru no Mi soul manipulation; homies like Zeus and Prometheus.
dream: Create a utopian nation where all races live together.
extra_notes: Her hunger pangs make her extremely unstable.

title: Marshall D. Teach (Blackbeard)
summary: Blackbeard is a ruthless pirate who wields two Devil Fruits after stealing Whitebeard's power.
abilities: Dark-Dark Fruit and Tremor-Tremor Fruit.
dream: Become the strongest pirate and reshape the world order.
extra_notes: His rise destabilizes the world.

title: Red-Haired Shanks
summary: Shanks is a Yonko who inspired Luffy to become a pirate.
abilities: Exceptionally powerful Haki.
dream: Maintain balance in the seas.
extra_notes: His crew is known for extremely high Haki skill.

title: Dracule Mihawk
summary: Mihawk is the world’s greatest swordsman and Zoro’s ultimate goal.
abilities: Unmatched swordsmanship with Yoru.
extra_notes: Trains Zoro for two years.

title: Cipher Pol
summary: Cipher Pol are secret intelligence agencies under the World Government.
extra_notes: CP0 becomes a major force later in the New World era.

title: Poneglyphs
summary: Poneglyphs are indestructible stones containing ancient writing.
extra_notes: Road Poneglyphs give the coordinates needed to reach Laugh Tale.

title: Fish-Man Island
summary: Fish-Man Island lies beneath the Red Line and is home to fish-men and merfolk.
extra_notes: Central themes include racism and coexistence; Jinbe plays a major role.

title: Aftermath of Wano
summary: After Wano, major shifts occur in global power, including new Yonko and alliances.
extra_notes: The balance of the world enters a new era following Kaido and Big Mom’s fall.

title: Monkey D. Dragon
summary: Dragon is Luffy’s father and the leader of the Revolutionary Army.
personality: Calm, strategic and devoted to freeing oppressed people.
abilities: Unconfirmed powers; implied weather or wind manipulation.
dream: Overthrow the World Government.
extra_notes: Considered the world's most dangerous criminal.

title: Sabo
summary: Sabo is Luffy and Ace’s sworn brother and the Revolutionary Army’s Chief of Staff.
abilities: Uses the Mera Mera no Mi and Advanced Haki.
dream: Fight tyranny and protect the weak.
extra_notes: Inherited Ace’s will through the flame fruit.

title: Portgas D. Ace
summary: Ace is Luffy’s sworn brother and a commander in Whitebeard’s crew.
abilities: Mera Mera no Mi fire powers.
dream: Help Whitebeard become Pirate King.
extra_notes: His death reshapes Luffy’s emotional journey.

title: Edward Newgate (Whitebeard)
summary: Whitebeard is one of the strongest pirates and a Yonko ruling vast territories.
personality: Fatherly, proud, values family over power.
abilities: Gura Gura no Mi causing massive earthquakes.
dream: Maintain his family of pirates.
extra_notes: Dies standing, symbolizing his strength and resolve.

title: Sakazuki (Akainu)
summary: Akainu is a Marine Admiral known for extreme justice, later becoming Fleet Admiral.
personality: Cold, ruthless, absolute in his ideology.
abilities: Magma-Magma Fruit.
dream: Impose absolute justice across the world.
extra_notes: Kills Ace during Marineford.

title: Kuzan (Aokiji)
summary: Aokiji is a former Marine Admiral with ice powers.
abilities: Ice-Ice Fruit.
dream: Seek his own justice.
extra_notes: Leaves the Marines after losing to Akainu.

title: Borsalino (Kizaru)
summary: Kizaru is a Marine Admiral with light-speed abilities.
abilities: Light-Light Fruit.
extra_notes: One of the most dangerous Admirals.

title: Gorosei
summary: The Gorosei are the highest governing body of the World Government.
extra_notes: They know the truths of the Void Century.

title: Celestial Dragons
summary: The Celestial Dragons are descendants of the founders of the World Government.
extra_notes: Their abuse of power causes major historical tensions.

title: Laboon
summary: Laboon is a giant whale waiting for the return of the Rumbar Pirates.
dream: Reunite with Brook.
extra_notes: Brook’s bond with Laboon is one of the saddest side stories.

title: Enel
summary: Enel rules Skypiea as a self-proclaimed god, wielding lightning powers.
abilities: Goro Goro no Mi lightning powers.
dream: Reach the moon and rule its inhabitants.
extra_notes: One of the strongest Logia users pre-timeskip.

title: Donquixote Doflamingo
summary: Doflamingo is a former Warlord and major criminal kingpin.
abilities: String-String Fruit enables cutting, control and cloning.
dream: Dominate the underground world.
extra_notes: His defeat exposes corruption throughout the world.

title: Trafalgar D. Water Law
summary: Law is a surgeon, pirate captain and Luffy’s major ally.
abilities: Ope Ope no Mi surgical space manipulation.
dream: Destroy Doflamingo’s legacy.
extra_notes: Forms the alliance that leads to Kaido’s downfall.

title: Eustass Kid
summary: Kid is a violent Supernova with magnetic abilities.
abilities: Jiki Jiki no Mi magnetism.
dream: Surpass other pirates and dominate the New World.
extra_notes: Fights alongside Law and Luffy against Big Mom.

title: Killer
summary: Killer is Kid’s right-hand man and a masked fighter.
abilities: Expert in scythe-based combat.
extra_notes: Forced to act as Kamazo the Manslayer.

title: Jewelry Bonney
summary: Bonney is a mysterious Supernova capable of altering ages.
abilities: Unknown age-manipulation fruit.
extra_notes: Linked directly to Kuma.

title: Bartholomew Kuma
summary: Kuma is a former Warlord and Revolutionary Army member.
abilities: Paw-Paw Fruit repulsion powers.
extra_notes: His sacrifice protects the Straw Hats.

title: CP0
summary: CP0 is the highest-level Cipher Pol unit, directly serving the Celestial Dragons.
extra_notes: The most powerful intelligence force in the Government.

title: Samurai of Wano
summary: The samurai of Wano fight to free their nation from Orochi and Kaido.
extra_notes: Loyal retainers of Kozuki Oden.
